description: Returns whether an appliance model is ENERGY STAR certified, or a list of certified models (most efficient first), from the EPA's official data. Categories: heat pumps, heat pump water heaters, clothes washers, clothes dryers, refrigerators, dishwashers. Heat pump answers include that federal 25C/25D tax credits ended after Dec 31, 2025. Applies to questions about whether an appliance model is ENERGY STAR certified, or which models in a category are certified. A store price and a recall notice are outside this result.

model.description: Model number or part of it, to check certification

most_efficient_only.description: Only models meeting ENERGY STAR Most Efficient criteria (not available for water heaters)

name: find_energy_star
title: Shopper: find ENERGY STAR models
